module: Skidpad test extension: teleports a vehicle to the "skidpadSpawn" start point then makes the AI follow the circuit defined by the waypoints skidpadWP1 to skidpadWP4 (2 laps). Uses util_stepHandler to chain the steps. The level must contain these scene objects.
notes: testResults is never filled by this file: getData() always returns nil (reset to nil at start).
cancelTest only raises a cancelTestRequested flag that is read nowhere: cancellation has no effect.
startTest assumes the "skidpadSpawn" object exists, otherwise Lua error (spawnPoint nil).

startTest.desc: Starts the sequence: safe teleport of the vehicle onto skidpadSpawn (orientation flipped 180°), wait 0.2 s, then ai.driveUsingPath on the waypoints skidpadWP1..4, WP1 with noOfLaps = 2 and aggression = 1.

vehId.desc: Identifier of the vehicle to test.

returns.desc: Always nil in this version (never filled).

cancelTest.desc: Raises the cancel flag (no real effect, see notes).
